7.4.4 Single Frame Handling during Reception
[SWS_FrArTp_00262] ⌈No state machine shall be used for the reception of an SF-x. When the corresponding connection is free, the single frame shall be forwarded immediately by calling PduR_FrArTpStartOfReception and, upon successful return of this function, PduRFrArTpCopyRxData and PduR_FrArTpRxIndication.⌋ The behavior in case of unsuccessful reception is described in [SWS_FrArTp_00298] and [SWS_FrArTp_00289].
